profile.headline: Software @ Expedia
profile.summary:
Hi 👋

I'm Kevin, a passionate software engineer with expertise in Python, Scala, Java, Kafka Streams, API development, Spark, and Airflow. I excel at solving complex problems involving data streams and scaling them at large. I bring strong analytical skills and value collaboration. Let's connect and innovate together!

positions.description: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Apache Spark Streaming · Spring Boot · Hive · API Development · Scala · Kafka Streams · Java · Apache Airflow · Apache Kafka

positions.title: Data Engineer
positions.description: Acquired by Optum Digital in Sept. 2021 and acquired by United Health Care Technology in Sept. 2022
positions.insights: Skills: Python · Apache Spark · Hadoop · Scala · Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Problem Solving · SQL · Computer Science

positions.title: Graduate Student Instructor - Data Manipulation and Analysis
positions.description:
• Created lab and homework assignments that utilize numpy and pandas to organize data structures and mentor students on concepts of data manipulation and analysis
• Created lesson plans that utilizes MapReduce, Hadoop and PySpark.sql to help students conduct large scale data computation for organization
• Create lesson plans and mentor students on conducting A|B testing on datasets from Mturk
• Teach students different analyses techniques such as regression models, multi-dimensionality reduction, clustering analysis, correlation matrix analysis, and time series analysis.
positions.insights: Skills: Python · Apache Spark · Hadoop · Problem Solving · SQL

positions.title: Data Science Intern
positions.description:
• Built a database on refugee connectivity data looking at internet usages from refugee camps across Europe from Meraki API
• Used text extraction tools including table extraction from NGO and UN agency reports in PDF format to create a database of for info retrieval for a search query
• Created the first and only pdf search engine for UN/NGO report that reduced time for non-profit workers by 95 percent from having to search in separate association websites to a single aggregated location with high precision for 217 pdfs from 3 different UN organizations (Read article here)
∗ Utilized Apache Tika to extract content from each pdf report, used BERT Summarizer to maintain a short summary for retrieval, SVD to remove noise from the summary and contents, and created a baseline model of word2vec cosine similarity.
∗ Created a model utilizing BM25L to reduce bias in other retrieval for longer documents that are more accurate
∗ F1-score and NDCG for BM25L were 0.66 and 0.8 (respectively) which were much higher than the baseline
(0.36, 0.66)
positions.insights: Skills: Python · Information Retrieval · Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) · Problem Solving · Machine Learning

positions.title: Data Scientist
positions.description:
• Parsed and extracted features from categorical variables for data visualization deployment
• Created a 6 page interactive data visualization dashboard on employee driven data for one of the largest fast food company
